> **Property Scope Declaration.** The price and estimated duration of this service are calculated
> entirely from the property details you provide at booking — bedrooms, bathrooms, powder rooms,
> living and dining areas, and any additional spaces you select. You warrant that this information
> is accurate and complete to the best of your knowledge at the time of booking.
>
> **On-Site Variance.** If, on arrival, our team reasonably determines that the property's actual
> size, room count or condition materially exceeds what was declared — such that the service cannot
> reasonably be completed to our standard within the allocated time — we will contact you before
> proceeding further, and document the variance (photographs and/or measurements) for our records.
>
> **Your Options.** Where a material variance arises, you may choose:
> (a) **Extend the service** at an additional rate of $100 per hour (or part thereof, billed in
> 30-minute increments) above the allocated time, payable in addition to your plan price; or
> (b) **Keep your plan price and time allocation.** We will complete the work in the priority order
> agreed with you at that time (or, where pre-agreed, the standard priority order for your service
> tier), and any remaining areas or tasks not completed within the allocated time will not be
> completed as part of that service, at no additional charge and with no discount against your plan
> price.
>
> **No Response.** If we are unable to reach you within approximately 15 minutes of attempting
> contact by phone, SMS and email, we will default to Option (b) so as not to delay our team's
> schedule, unless you have pre-authorised Option (a) in writing.
>
> **Repeat Variance.** Where the same property shows a material variance from its declared scope on
> a second occasion, we reserve the right to require an in-person or video property assessment
> before confirming any further instant-quote bookings for that address.
